evidence.baseline_lane_b2_feed_is_sip: factory/artifacts/basket/data_provenance.json families.'backfill/clean_ohlcv_2026-03..2026-08': provider Alpaca, feed SIP, producer factory/scripts/backfill_alpaca.py (raw) then clean_month.py. evidence.compact_sip_feed_is_sip: data/sip/universe/rth/<day>.parquet is the day's own SIP query of the same PIT roster (alpaca-py), unfiltered: the primary same-feed evidence of 'this name printed'. It carries per-symbol bar counts, not bars, so it cannot yield witness rows - and it never needs to, because it IS the acquisition feed and its zeros are hard.
evidence.dxr_2025_02_03: the case that forced this policy. The replaced B1 fallback carries one 12:55 ET bar for DXR (O=H=L=C=7.78, volume 124); the SIP minute-bar response returns no bar (a second independent SIP pull agrees), while the SIP trade endpoint shows 24 prints / 501 shares, every print an auction or odd-lot condition for which the provider emits no minute bar, and the daily bar is n=0/v=0. Not a non-trader, not a tape revision, not an identity or alias problem: a cross-feed disagreement, preserved and reported.
evidence.why_pins: each declared source carries a sha256 pin per month where the lane is durable. A pin that no longer matches the file on disk means the origin archive was replaced or edited, and every claim made against it is void.

forbidden: blockers_resolved.json (resolution is the parent verification's act and needs its own evidence shas)
declaring a cross-feed witness a non-trader, or relabelling its rows as SIP
requiring the currently installed tool hash to equal a historical producer's hash
re-pointing a blocker at another blocker's already-verified root, or changing its pinned producer/contract
refetching or rewriting any day of a root whose bytes are pinned by a capture
principle: A source may oblige the acquisition to emit a SIP minute bar only when its own feed identity equals the acquisition feed. A source whose feed identity is unknown or different cannot demand a bar the SIP feed does not build: its observation is reported, its ORIGINAL rows are preserved, and the archive stays authoritative for that proxy. It is never called a non-trader and never relabelled as SIP.

checks: schema is atlas.acquisition.source-policy.v0 and acquisition_feed is the feed this producer acquires
every feed class in REQUIRED_FEED_CLASSES is declared with exactly the semantics fixed in code, so a policy cannot relabel a feed to change whose evidence counts
every source declares role, feed, a data-root-relative path_template and a counts_window, and its feed class exists
every source whose feed is NOT the acquisition feed is witness_rows_available and counts on the same closed projection window (its preserved rows must be exactly reproducible)

the per_blocker set is exactly the blocker ids this producer knows, each with the matching scope, a version, a root_rel, an attestation_rel and sources that include an obligation_evidence source and a baseline source
each blocker's declared expected_days equals the dev calendar via full_scope_day_set() (19 for B1, 41 for B2)
each blocker's producer snapshot exists, and its digest IS both the pinned snapshot_sha256 and code_sha256_at_capture; likewise the contract snapshot and contract_sha256_at_capture
every declared lane pin still hashes to the file on disk, and the file exists
validator.run_by: validate_policy() on every plan/acquire/verify/publish run, before any file is opened
validator.writes: nothing. This policy is read-only to the producer; publishing the admission is a separate act that never writes blockers_resolved.json

witness_rule: cross_feed_witnesses/<day>.parquet, inside the blocker's own root, holds the ORIGINAL in-window rows of a source whose feed is not the acquisition feed, keyed by (parent_sha256, row_ordinal, canonical_time_utc) with the source name, path, feed, provider, its observed in-window count and fresh_n_bars=0. It is a preserved proxy sibling: never under bars/, never a SIP lane input, never part of the SIP payload digest, and never evidence that a name did not trade.
